title: ccc-node initial fleet inventory descriptor v1 (part of #1451 P0)
description: Initial node-local fleet inventory data contract, only part of #1451 P0. Never sourced, evaluated or interpolated into shell source. References no key material. Structural validation is insufficient: URL parsing and existing consumer transport/trust policies remain required. Relay/team/wiki/keyring-source routing remains undefined. No consumer reads this file yet.

version.description: Descriptor version. Numeric value 1 only at the JSON Schema layer; the separate strict syntax profile rejects floating-point lexical forms such as 1.0.

nodes.description: Every node the fleet declares, including this one. Aliases are unique (semantic rule; not expressible in the keyword subset).

alias.description: SSH host alias and join key. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphen, 2-32 characters, first character a letter so the value can never be parsed as a command-line option. No dots, no whitespace, no shell metacharacters, no user@host form and no path separators.

platform.description: Node execution substrate. Selects which node-local expectations apply (systemd units vs Termux cron). An unlisted platform is rejected rather than treated as linux-systemd.

roles.description: Lanes this node participates in. An empty array is explicit and legal: the node is addressable but runs no declared lane. Role tokens are a closed enum; adding one is a schema change.

repoRoot.description: Absolute path of this node's ccc-node checkout. No trailing slash, no empty or repeated separators, no relative or dot-leading component, so '..' and hidden-directory traversal cannot be expressed.

endpoint.description: Optional HTTP or HTTPS URL, at most 2048 characters. This pattern is only a coarse structural screen, not a URL parser or transport policy. A future consumer must parse/validate host or IP, port and path, reject userinfo/query/fragment and preserve its existing transport/trust policy. HTTP loopback tunnels are representable; neither scheme nor host implies authorization.

keyRef.description: Optional keyring identifier for this node's worker signing key, in the existing worker:<node>:g<generation>:v<version> form. A reference only: never a key, fingerprint, or any other material. Its <node> segment must equal this entry's alias (semantic rule).

enabled.description: Whether the node is currently in service. Required: a missing value is an error, never an implied true.
